title: Pythagorean Identity
prompt:
Simplify the trigonometric expression to its simplest form:

    sin²(x) + cos²(x)

Enter the simplified result.
hint: the Pythagorean identity — functions are written sin(x), cos(x)
recap: The Pythagorean identity sin^2(x) + cos^2(x) = 1 holds for every x (it's the unit circle's equation) and collapses many trig expressions to a constant.
